model.formula: value_density = sum(impact components) / effort_days. All inputs are register fields; none is inferred.
model.not_a_risk_model: This ranks documented gaps by impact-per-effort using the register's own fields. It does not estimate the probability that a gap causes harm, and two rows with identical fields may still deserve a different order. It narrows the field; it does not decide.
